headline: Chetankumar Timbadia files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: **Chetankumar Timbadia has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure of substantial acquisition of shares in NSE-listed DC Infotech and Communication Limited.** The filing triggers mandatory public disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code.
detail: Chetankumar Timbadia has submitted a disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31(4) mandates that when a person acquires 5% or more of the voting capital of a listed company (or increases their holding to trigger reporting), disclosure must be made within two trading days. This filing indicates a substantial share acquisition has occurred; pending the PDF's full content, the exact percentage, acquisition date, and consideration cannot be confirmed from available public sources.
